'''I-Zellam''' was an [[I-Zellam's species|alien]] who spent [[time]] in [[Olega City]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> he<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> was stood in the doorway of a building in the [[city]] interacting with another individual when the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] passed by in the street. When Aniseya's twin, [[Verosha Aniseya]], later passed down a nearby street, I-Zellam was gesticulating angrily at a [[human]] carrying a barrel at the bottom of a set of steps leading onto the street.<ref name="RJ">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref>

I-Zellam had keen sensory organs that were clustered around his trunk, [[ear]]s, and horns, which made him impeccably qualified to detect expert craftwork among handmade goods. He had [[Color|tan]] fur and skin and reddish-gold [[eye]]s.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> I-Zellam wore brown [[Clothing|pants]] with a black [[belt]], a black and red [[kama]], a brown [[bandolier]], and brown shoes.<ref name="RJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
I-Zellam appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]],"  the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'',<ref name="RJ" /> [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> He was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
